content_text: Hi Roger, what are your thoughts on the concept of a cleaner anamorphic like an Arri master anamorphic or servicevision Scorpio? Anamorphic lenses that attempt to rectify the technical imperfections of anamorphics of the past like distortion, vignetting, flares, and the like? Do you think there’s a place for this kind of lens? I know some here (like Mullen) are split on it but I wanna know your thoughts on this area of lensing
